the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Compute the support of the tensor product as the union over the support of the second sheaf of the fibre supports, giving a closed subset of the sum delta-dimension so the displayed cycle class is defined, identify the irreducible components appearing in the cap product with those of the support of the tensor product of the sum dimension using the notation of the construction, reduce to a length identity at the generic points of those components, translate the identity into an equality between the length of a tensor product of a finite length module with a flat module and the product of the lengths of its reductions, use flatness to see both sides are additive in the finite length module, and conclude with the residue field case where the identity is immediate (source lines 2373-2429)
